title: Thought Experiments and Universal Principles with Si Clauses

sections.content:
You know realistic conditionals (*si* + present + future) from B1 Unit 8 and hypothetical conditionals (*si* + imperfect subjunctive + conditional) from B1 Unit 4, and mixed conditionals (*si* + imperfect subjunctive + *habría* + participle) from B2 Unit 11. Philosophical argument puts them to work in two classic patterns:

• **Universal gnomic conditionals (*si* + present + present)**: state an ethical rule or test it with a counterexample (*Si una regla perjudica al inocente, carece de legitimidad*; *Si quebrantamos una promesa sin causa, debilitamos el vínculo social*).
• **Mixed conditionals (*si* + imperfect subjunctive + conditional perfect *habría* + participle)**: connect a timeless ethical condition to a past outcome (*Si no existiera la confianza mutua, ningún pacto habría durado*).

sections.title: Universal rules and mixed thought experiments
rows: Si una norma beneficia solo a unos pocos, pierde legitimidad.
If a norm benefits only a few, it loses legitimacy. (universal rule)
Si quebrantáramos cada promesa difícil, la palabra perdería valor.
If we broke every difficult promise, one's word would lose value. (hypothetical)
Si no existiera el respeto mutuo, el acuerdo habría fracasado.
If mutual respect did not exist, the agreement would have failed. (mixed)
Si ese principio fuera universal, habría evitado aquel conflicto.
If that principle were universal, it would have avoided that conflict. (mixed)

items.spanish: Un buen contraejemplo muestra que, si una regla perjudica a terceros inocentes, pierde legitimidad.
items.english: A good counterexample shows that, if a rule harms innocent third parties, it loses legitimacy.

items.spanish: Si nadie cumpliera su promesa cuando resulta incómoda, el vínculo de confianza desaparecería.
items.english: If nobody kept their promise when it becomes inconvenient, the bond of trust would disappear.

items.spanish: Si el altruismo no existiera en las sociedades humanas, pocas instituciones habrían sobrevivido.
items.english: If altruism did not exist in human societies, few institutions would have survived.

items.spanish: Si una excepción beneficia a la comunidad sin dañar a nadie, ¿sigue siendo reprochable quebrantar la regla?
items.english: If an exception benefits the community without harming anyone, is breaking the rule still blameworthy?

sections.content: Never place the conditional (*habría*, *sería*) directly after *si* (`*Si existiría la confianza...*` is always wrong). In a mixed conditional, the *si*-clause takes the imperfect subjunctive (*-ra* or *-se*) for a general condition, and the main clause takes the conditional perfect (*habría* + participle) for the past consequence.
